definitions.explanation: A lack of trust or confidence in someone or something. Commonly used in political and institutional contexts.
Acting without good faith or sincerity in dealings with others.

examples.japanese: {政治|せいじ}{不信|ふしん}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
{内閣|ないかく}{不信任|ふしんにん}{案|あん}が{提出|ていしゅつ}された。
examples.english: A no-confidence motion was submitted against the cabinet.

examples.japanese: {度重|たびかさ}なる{不祥事|ふしょうじ}が{国民|こくみん}の{不信|ふしん}を{招|まね}いた。
examples.english: The repeated scandals invited public distrust.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}の{不信|ふしん}な{態度|たいど}に{怒|おこ}った。
examples.english: I was angered by the other party's bad-faith attitude.

examples.japanese: {不信|ふしん}な{行為|こうい}があった{場合|ばあい}は{報告|ほうこく}してください。
examples.english: Please report any acts of bad faith.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}{交渉|こうしょう}における{不信|ふしん}な{対応|たいおう}が{問題|もんだい}になった。
examples.english: Insincere conduct during contract negotiations became an issue.

notes:
USAGE:
Often appears in compound forms like {政治|せいじ}{不信|ふしん} (political distrust), {不信任|ふしんにん} (no confidence), and {不信感|ふしんかん} (sense of distrust).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不信|ふしん}を{抱|いだ}く (to harbor distrust)
- {不信|ふしん}を{招|まね}く (to invite distrust)
- {不信感|ふしんかん} (sense of distrust)
- {不信任|ふしんにん}{案|あん} (no-confidence motion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不審|ふしん}: suspicion, doubt — focuses on finding something questionable (homophone with different kanji)
- {不振|ふしん}: slump, poor performance — another homophone, about underperformance
- {疑惑|ぎわく}: suspicion, doubt — about suspected wrongdoing
